Name: Lumisteria Festival Additions - Fair Edition
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: This mod currently change the fair festival to make it a bit more interesting to see again. Cosmetic changes and dialogue changes only.
Description:
Lumisteria Festival Additions - Fair Edition

**New** : russian translation is now available in a separate download. Thanks to "6squad" for this !

This mod makes some visual and dialogue changes to make the Fair more interesting to revisit. Your rivals at the fair have some new stuff to show, and there are some other changes to see.
Since most of the interest of the mod is in the discovery of the new stuff, i choose to not show most of them in the screenshot to keep the pleasure of discovery intact !

The changes will happen since year 2, with some being guaranteed to happen and some being random.

Note : you need the version 1.11 of CP, since this mod will use random token to bring a bit of well, randomness :D.

This mod should be compatible with SVE. If you use a dialogue mod, my changes may not be visible, let me know and i'll ensure the dialogue mod is loading before mine !

Special thanks to :

[SDWinchester](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/76130918) for their help with some part of the mod !
